tagline: Healthy hair starts at the root.
description: Rootwell is a fictional Singapore scalp-care studio: free scalp analysis, head spa and hair-loss programmes for men and women. Portfolio demo.

hero.title: Healthy hair starts at the root.
hero.lead: Start with a free 20-minute scalp check. See what is going on under the scope, then decide.

promo.title: Scalp reset trial, S$38.
promo.body: Usual price S$128. Scalp check, detox cleanse and a 20-minute head spa. Demo offer.

services.title: Scalp check
services.summary: Twenty minutes under a scalp camera, then a plain-English summary of what we see.

services.title: Signature head spa
services.summary: Deep cleanse, scalp massage and steam. The calmest hour of your week.

services.title: Scalp detox
services.summary: Clears build-up and excess oil to settle an itchy, flaky or oily scalp.

services.title: Thinning hair programme
services.summary: A 12-week coached plan with monthly scope photos to track progress.

pricing.title: Head spa pricing
pricing.intro: Your scalp check is free. After that, pay per visit or commit only if it is working.

whyUs.title: Check first, then decide
whyUs.body: A free scalp check shows you what is happening before you spend anything.

whyUs.title: Coaching, not scare tactics
whyUs.body: We explain what is normal, what is not, and what you can do at home.

whyUs.title: Progress you can see
whyUs.body: Scope photos at every visit, so you can judge results yourself.

testimonials.quote: I was sceptical. The check was quick, nobody tried to sell me a programme, and the advice was practical.
testimonials.name: Arjun K.

testimonials.quote: Three months in and the scope photos show it. My scalp has stopped itching at the end of the day.
testimonials.name: Benjamin S.

testimonials.quote: The head spa is now my monthly reset. Calm room, no chatter unless you want it.
testimonials.name: Lina W.

faqs.question: Is the scalp check really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Twenty minutes with a scalp coach and a camera, then a summary. There is nothing to buy at the end.

faqs.question: Is Rootwell only for hair loss?
faqs.answer: No. Most visitors come for an oily, itchy or flaky scalp, or simply to relax with a head spa.

faqs.question: Do you treat men?
faqs.answer: Yes. About half of our visitors are men, and every outlet has private rooms.

faqs.question: When should I see a doctor instead?
faqs.answer: If you have sudden patchy hair loss, pain or open sores, see a doctor first. We will tell you if we think that is the right step.

faqs.question: Do prices include GST?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every price shown includes 9% GST.

closing.title: Start with a 20-minute scalp check.
closing.body: Free, no obligation. Then decide what, if anything, comes next.

footer.blurb: Scalp care and head spa, coached calmly. A fictional demo brand.
